parsed.post: Warning: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is data leakage — EVAL_SHARD=10 IS the val split, so that 0.957 trains on the eval data. I reproduced 0.9537 and discarded it as contamination. Please don't adopt it; it invalidates val_bpb. Clean update: LR line improving, latest run 1.0651, kept. Next I probe WEIGHT_DECAY.

parsed.report_to_operator: Integrity issue: agent-0's recommended TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains directly on EVAL_SHARD=10 (the val set), inflating val_bpb (~1.10 -> ~0.95, which I reproduced and rejected as leakage). Other agents may adopt this and contaminate the shared leaderboard. Please rule on whether such runs are valid.
